properties.Title: Vishnu Purana III.2: Chhāyā and Śanaiścara (H. H. Wilson, 1840)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Puranic narrative: Sanjñā leaves Chhāyā (her shadow) with Sūrya; Chhāyā bears Śanaiścara (Saturn). Used for reel R05 'Child of the Shadow'.
properties.Credibility notes: 19th-c. translation; Wilson's own notes reflect his era. Read in full via sacred-texts (curl, page blocked to fetch tool).

properties.Title: Katha Upanishad I.2: the good (śreyas) and the pleasant (preyas) (Max Müller, SBE 15)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. I.2.1–2: 'The good is one thing, the pleasant another'; the wise choose the good. Supports postponement/choice reframe (not about Shani).
properties.Credibility notes: Public-domain translation, archaic English; quote with translator.

properties.Title: Bhagavad Gita ch. II (2.14, 2.47, 2.62–63) (K. T. Telang, SBE 8)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 2.14 endure contacts that come and go; 2.47 right to action, not to fruits; 2.62–63 dwelling on objects → attachment → desire → anger. Used for 'karma as action, not reward'.
properties.Credibility notes: Telang 1882 public domain; verse numbers checked in text.

properties.Title: Bhagavad Gita ch. III (3.8) (K. T. Telang, SBE 8)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 3.8: action is better than inaction. Used against 'waiting until ready'.
properties.Credibility notes: Telang 1882 public domain.

properties.Title: Bhagavad Gita ch. VI (6.35) (K. T. Telang, SBE 8)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 6.35: the restless mind is restrained by practice and dispassion. Telang wording; complements existing holy-bhagavad-gita 6.35 row.
properties.Credibility notes: Telang 1882 public domain. A 6.5 line was NOT found in this translation and is not used.

properties.Title: Bhagavad Gita ch. XVIII (18.37–38) (K. T. Telang, SBE 8)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 18.37–38: happiness like poison at first and nectar at the end (sattvic) vs nectar first, poison later (rajasic). Used for discipline vs pleasure framing.
properties.Credibility notes: Telang 1882 public domain.

properties.Title: Śani / Shani: Wisdomlib definitions (Monier-Williams, Purana Index, iconography)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Monier-Williams: Śani 'probably slow-moving', also Saturday. Purana Index cites Matsya Purana 11.9 for attaining planetary status by penance. Iconographic notes (e.g., tortoise).
properties.Credibility notes: Aggregator of dictionaries/encyclopedias. Matsya 11.9 claim NOT verified in a primary text: do not use publicly without checking.

properties.Title: Shani (Wikipedia)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Tertiary overview: epithets (Śanaiścara, Chhāyāsuta), associations with karma, time, justice; crow vahana; Saturday worship.
properties.Credibility notes: Tertiary; used only for devotional associations and epithets, cross-checked with Wisdomlib/VP. Not cited for doctrine.

properties.Title: Saturn facts (NASA Science)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Orbit about 29.4 Earth years (10,756 days); day about 10.7 hours. Basis of 'The Slow Planet' territory.
properties.Credibility notes: Authoritative science agency; astronomy only, never used to support astrology.

properties.Title: Integrating theories of motivation: procrastination meta-analysis (Steel, Psychol Bull 2007)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 691 correlations: task aversiveness, delay, self-efficacy, impulsiveness predict procrastination.
properties.Credibility notes: Meta-analysis. Abstract read via NCBI E-utilities efetch (PubMed page blocks automated fetch).

properties.Title: Procrastination as short-term mood repair: review (Zhang, Liu & Feng, WIREs Cogn Sci 2019)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Procrastination framed as prioritising short-term mood repair over long-term goals; neural/cognitive review.
properties.Credibility notes: Narrative review. Abstract read via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Making health habitual: habit formation and general practice (Gardner, Lally & Wardle, Br J Gen Pract 2012)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Summarises Lally et al.: automaticity plateaued at 66 days on average (with considerable variation across people and behaviours); missing an occasional opportunity did not seriously impair habit formation. Basis for 'missed days remove nothing'.
properties.Credibility notes: Peer-reviewed narrative article; full text read on PMC. Underlying study n=96, self-report.

properties.Title: Just think: the challenges of the disengaged mind (Wilson et al., Science 2014)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Participants found 6–15 min alone with thoughts unpleasant; 12 of 18 men and 6 of 24 women self-administered a shock. Used in R09 (Skeptic).
properties.Credibility notes: Peer-reviewed; full text read on PMC. Student samples; cite exact numbers only.

properties.Title: A multisite preregistered replication of ego depletion (Hagger et al., Perspect Psychol Sci 2016)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 23 labs, effect near zero: willpower-as-fuel claims are not reliable. Campaign avoids 'willpower runs out' messaging.
properties.Credibility notes: Registered replication report. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Taking stock of self-control: meta-analysis (de Ridder et al., PSPR 2012)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Trait self-control relates more strongly to automatic behaviours/habits than to effortful inhibition. Supports 'design the environment' (boundary) framing.
properties.Credibility notes: Meta-analysis (102 studies). Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Distress tolerance: review (Leyro, Zvolensky & Bernstein, Psychol Bull 2010)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Distress tolerance as the perceived/actual ability to withstand negative states; linked to avoidance. Used for 'staying with discomfort' reels.
properties.Credibility notes: Review; full text read on PMC. Campaign makes no clinical claims.

properties.Title: Surfing the urge: brief mindfulness intervention for smokers (Bowen & Marlatt, Psychol Addict Behav 2009)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Urge-surfing instruction reduced cigarettes smoked at follow-up vs control, without changing urge intensity. Basis for 'watch the reach' practice.
properties.Credibility notes: Small RCT with smokers; generalising to phone urges is our interpretation. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: The attentional cost of receiving a cell phone notification (Stothart, Mitchum & Yehnert, JEP:HPP 2015)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Notifications alone (not answered) disrupted performance on an attention task, comparable to active phone use. Used in R11.
properties.Credibility notes: Lab study. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Reexamining the 'brain drain' effect: replication (Ruiz Pardo & Minda, Acta Psychol 2022)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Failed to replicate the claim that mere phone presence reduces cognitive capacity. Campaign avoids 'your phone drains your brain' claims.
properties.Credibility notes: Replication. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Future self-continuity (Hershfield, Ann NY Acad Sci 2011)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. People who feel less connected to their future selves make more short-sighted choices. Supports 'Saturn's 29-year orbit / future you' reframe.
properties.Credibility notes: Review; full text read on PMC.

properties.Title: Experiential avoidance and behavioral disorders (Hayes et al., J Consult Clin Psychol 1996)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Defines experiential avoidance (unwillingness to stay in contact with private experiences). Frames escaping discomfort/silence.
properties.Credibility notes: Conceptual/functional paper; clinical context; no clinical claims made. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Does changing intentions engender behavior change? Meta-analysis (Webb & Sheeran, Psychol Bull 2006)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. 47 experiments: medium-to-large intention change (d=0.66) produced small-to-medium behaviour change (d=0.36). The intention–behaviour gap.
properties.Credibility notes: Meta-analysis. Abstract via NCBI efetch.

properties.Title: Mechanisms of implementation intention effects (Webb & Sheeran, Br J Soc Psychol 2008)
properties.Key Context: Campaign use: Shanivar Launch Campaign (Saturn's Wisdom), Oct 2026. Implementation intentions work by making the cue and the response accessible, not by boosting motivation. Basis for fixed-time 'Shanivar Hour'.
properties.Credibility notes: Peer-reviewed experiments. Abstract via NCBI efetch.
